description.zh:
保证请求幂等性，从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。

ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。

> 若用户未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request.

description.zh: 文件系统和虚拟存储通道的 ID 信息，每批次最多 10 个。
description.en: The ID information of the file system and virtual storage channel. A maximum of 10 entries can be specified per batch.

description.zh:
角色链。
>仅跨账号场景需要。
description.en:
The role chain.
> This parameter is required only for cross-account scenarios.

title.zh: 取消VSC设备关联到文件系统
title.en: Dissociate a VSC device from a file system

descriptions.zh:
- 仅CPFS智算版支持该功能。
- 支持批量执行，批量执行情况下，目前仅支持1个VscId关联到多个FileSystemId，即ResourceIds.VscId需相等。
descriptions.en:
- Only CPFS for Lingjun supports this feature.
- Batch operations are supported. In batch mode, only one VscId can be associated with multiple FileSystemIds. This means the ResourceIds.VscId values must be the same.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun nas detach-vsc-from-filesystems --resource-ids VscId=vsc-8vb864o3ppwfvh0000 FileSystemId=bmcpfs-290t15yn4uo8lid0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --role-chain AssumeRoleFor=5283941832250000 RoleType=service RoleArn=acs:ram::1234722338140000:role/aliyunnasclientvsc0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun nas DetachVscFromFilesystems --region cn-hangzhou --RoleChain.1.RoleArn 'acs:ram::1234722338140000:role/aliyunnasclientvsc0000' --RoleChain.1.AssumeRoleFor 5283941832250000 --ResourceIds.1.FileSystemId 'bmcpfs-290t15yn4uo8lid0000' --ResourceIds.1.VscId 'vsc-8vb864o3ppwfvh0000' --RoleChain.1.RoleType service --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --method POST --force
